subject: Upcoming Travel Booking Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], We are pleased to inform you that your upcoming travel booking to Paris has been successfully confirmed. Your flight details are as follows: Departure: 10th August 2022, 09:00 AM Return: 15th August 2022, 06:00 PM Please ensure you have all necessary documents and travel essentials ready for your trip. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Safe travels, The Travel Agency Team
